message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts.

Facts: From May to Dec 2007, defendant Wang claimed to be able to purchase a house in Lugang community, etc., and used purchase of garage, handling house deed etc. to defraud victim Hong of total 115,000 RMB. Then when victim wanted to report to police, Wang preemptively reported to police claiming victim defrauded him of 640,000 RMB, and had friend He give false testimony, intending to make victim face criminal liability. So Wang committed fraud (contract fraud?) He used false statements to induce victim to give money for purchase of property that doesn't exist. That's contract fraud (合同诈骗). Also he made false report and false testimony to police, which is false accusation (诬告陷害). The list includes "诬告陷害". Indeed he fabricated a false report to police accusing victim of fraud. That is false accusation. So charges: 合同诈骗; 诬告陷害. Also maybe "诈骗" generic? But we need specific: contract fraud is appropriate. The example earlier: they used "合同诈骗" for contract fraud. So include that. Also "诬告陷害". Any other? He also possibly "伪证"? Not in list. So final answer: 合同诈骗;诬告陷害.
